messages:
Priya N: Hello! First-day snag  My Okta invite link says 'user already exists' even though I never completed setup. I have two Google aliases (priya.n@redwood.dev and priya.nair@contractors.redwood.dev). Also tried to enroll a passkey on macOS but Safari throws 'unable to create credential'. 1Password invite not in my inbox. Who should I ping for a temp access route?

Ravi (IT): Welcome Priya! Can you paste the exact invite address? The contractor domain might have been used for a placeholder account. And for Safari passkeys, try Chrome or use the Okta Verify app on your phone as a fallback.

Priya N: Invite went to priya.nair@contractors.redwood.dev. Error text: "Duplicate account found (E220)". I tried Chrome incognito and same error. Phone enroll didn't work earlier either 914.

Liam - People Ops: Sorry about that62c. I'll add you to "onboarding-temp" so you get calendars/docs while IT untangles the account. Do you need immediate GitHub access?

Priya N: Docs + calendar for now. No code access yet. 1Password is more urgent for secrets access but can wait an hour.

Ravi (IT): I'll investigate the duplicate. Sometimes a pre-provisioned contractor stub uses the contractor address. I'll merge/remove the stub and reissue an invite to your base address priya.n@redwood.dev. If passkey still fails, we'll issue a temporary magic link so you can finish setup without hardware and then force-enable MFA later. Opening ticket IT-54021.

onboard-bot: [automated] Ticket IT-54021 created 4dd "Okta duplicate account (contractor domain) + passkey fail for Priya N". Assigned to Ravi (IT). ETA 2h.

Ravi (IT): Update: removed the stale contractor stub and resent an invite to priya.n@redwood.dev. I also generated a one-time magic link and DMed it to you (expires 10h). Please try the magic link in a private window.

Priya N: Tried magic link in private window, and account creation completed. Enrolled Okta Verify on my phone and set up SMS fallback. Still no 1Password invite though.

Liam - People Ops: I requested a 1Password seat (PL-1108) and escalated to vendor. You should get the invite in ~30 mins. Meanwhile I added you to onboarding-temp and to the Docs folder with view/edit. Welcome to Redwood! 389

Priya N: Got the 1Password invite and set up access. All set now 44d. Thanks Ravi and Liam for the quick help.

Ravi (IT): Great! If you want to switch from SMS to passkey or YubiKey later, open a ticket and we'll add the hardware factor. Enjoy your first day :)
